name: generate_designed_pdf
description: Design and generate a professional PDF layout using the provided content, data, and file paths. This skill is responsible for transforming sufficient user-supplied content into a visually polished HTML/CSS design and then generating the final PDF through a focused sub-agent that handles presentation and formatting.

content.description: Exact material to include in the PDF (body copy, lists, tables as text, etc.). The sub-agent must not invent or replace facts; only structure and style them.

designBrief.description: Optional: visual direction (e.g. minimalist, brand colors, resume vs report). Does not supply new factual content.

outputPath.description: Where to save the PDF under workspace/.
